name: MVGS_THERAPY_RESPONSE
title: MV-GenomSeq therapy response
description: Response of the tumour to a performed systemic therapy as reported in the genomDE KDK follow-up (followUp.followUpOds[].therapies[].therapyResponse / .therapyResponseDate / .therapyResponseSource). Local profile on core Observation because mii-pr-mtb-response-befund requires Observation.method 1..1 (RECIST/RANO), which genomDE does not transmit (DISCUSS-TD #14). Response code from the MII MTB CodeSystem mii-cs-mtb-response-befund-beurteilung; the data source (Arztbrief, Tumordokumentation, ...) goes to note.
